# Repositories that carry the org npm release template as .github/workflows/release.yml. The family
# check (release-family-check.yml) reads each one at the commit its default branch points to. One
# owner/name per line; add a repository in the PR that adopts the template, so the check covers it
# from the first release. A repository that publishes but is missing from this list is not seen.
